license.training_source: Pepper&Carrot official English compiled pages by David Revoy, CC BY 4.0
license.attribution: David Revoy; episode-specific source pages and credits are listed in data/peppercarrot/manifest.json

test_split.name: test
test_split.split_policy: whole episodes; no pages from one episode cross splits

quality_gate.criteria: all requested scales/strengths have nonnegative aggregate delta over bicubic; JPEG35/60/88 plus light-blur 1x improves; clean1x bias <0.5 gray, p95 <=3 gray, max <=6 gray at strength100 and <=4 gray at strength60; per-sample AI-vs-bicubic maximum respects scale-aware raw residual cap

scale_aware_residual_cap.formula: limit=0.02+slope*(actual_scale_x-1); clamp raw residual to [-limit,+limit] before strength

input_quantization: clamp to [0,1], round to nearest 8-bit RGB, then divide by 255
